title: DIR-096: Autonomous Production Convergence Engine — End-to-End Implementation, Refactoring, RCA, Contract Verification & Release Certification Against Master Manifest 4.2.0
spec:
SECTION 1: EXECUTIVE MANDATE & STRATEGIC CONTEXT
This executive engineering directive establishes the Master Autonomous Convergence Engine for ResumePilotAI (IME365), commanding Antigravity (Executive Lead & Gatekeeper) and Cline (Senior Staff Developer) to autonomously refactor, RCA, fix, reiterate, and drive the entire application to 100% production completeness.

PRIMARY SOURCE OF TRUTH (MANDATORY — READ FIRST):
  • docs/contracts/manifest.json  (Master manifest, schema version 4.2.0)
  • docs/build/tasks.json         (Executable task graph, 118 tasks)
  • docs/contracts/openapi.yaml   (OpenAPI 3.1, generated from openapiInline)
  • docs/contracts/schema.sql     (Canonical DDL, generated from ddlInline)

All counts, routes, routers, tables, tests, and contracts MUST be read from the manifest, never restated in prose. Any number appearing in this directive is illustrative; the manifest is authoritative.

SCOPE:
1. Four-Portal Ecosystem: Candidate Portal (15 routes), Employer Talent Suite (5 routes), Enterprise Multi-Tenant Administration (6 routes), SuperAdmin Operations Console (5 routes), plus 33 public/marketing and 4 system utility routes = 68 total routes (manifest.routeInventory.total).
2. Backend API Conformance: Validate and harden all 29 routers (manifest.backendApiTopology.routers) against the 17 inline OpenAPI contracts (manifest.openapiInline) using the response envelope { data, error, meta, requestId }.
3. MariaDB Schema Integrity: 117 tables (manifest.databaseSchema.totalTables), 25 migration files, 26 canonical inline DDL definitions (manifest.ddlInline) with strict foreign key, tenant isolation, and rollback policy.
4. Export Pipelines & Template Parity: 51 resume templates locked under 0-byte diff lock; DOCX adaptive partitioner; @media print PDF contract.
5. AI Capabilities & Multi-Provider Resilience: Executive Bio, Speech-to-Speech CBT Audio Coach, ATS Score Engine, with fail-closed circuit breakers, PII redaction, cost controls, and extractJson normalization.
6. UI/UX Design System Conformance: Full manifest.uiuxSystem — token schema, 12-component inventory, screen-state matrix on every route, motion spec, form spec, content design rules, navigation IA, WCAG 2.1 AA, zero horizontal overflow across 7 viewports.
7. Test Pyramid: 292 suites (manifest.qualityAssuranceAndTesting.totalTestSuites), 80% statement coverage, all CI gates green.

SECTION 2: PLAN MODE VS ACT MODE BOUNDARIES
- PLAN MODE:
  Perform complete architectural reconnaissance against docs/contracts/manifest.json and the physical codebase.
  Submit an ordered multi-wave implementation plan (summary + ordered steps) via 'bridge dev plan' and WAIT for formal Lead approval.
  Cross-reference every task against docs/build/tasks.json. Do not add tasks that are not in the graph without Lead approval.
  MUST NOT edit application code, alter schemas, or execute state-changing operations.
- ACT MODE (upon Lead approval):
  Execute docs/build/tasks.json in dependency order, honoring per-task acceptanceCriteria, evidenceRequired, definitionOfDone, and rollbackPlan.
  Continuous closed-loop iteration: IMPLEMENT -> TEST -> CRAWL -> RCA -> FIX -> RETEST -> COMPARE -> PROVE.
  Emit heartbeats (<= 480s) via 'bridge dev heartbeat'. Submit Level 5 evidence via 'bridge dev submit-evidence'.
  Escalate after 30 minutes BLOCKED via manifest.buildSpecification.escalationPolicy.

SECTION 3: AUTONOMOUS RCA & DEFECT REMEDIATION LOOP
- Never patch symptoms. Trace every failure, regression, or visual anomaly to root cause.
- Differentiate environment (sandbox/permissions) from code (logic/runtime/concurrency) failures.
- Apply smallest safe fix idempotently, then re-run the full regression suite to prove zero regression.
- Every fix must include a regression test added to the pyramid.

SECTION 4: SURGICAL FILE TARGETS
1. Frontend Architecture & Portals:
   • src/main.jsx
   • src/components/Candidate/CubaCandidateShell.jsx
   • src/components/Dashboard/** (15 Candidate routes)
   • src/components/EmployerPortal/** (5 Employer routes)
   • src/enterprise/EnterpriseConsole.jsx (+ src/enterprise/pages/**)
   • src/components/admin/Admin.jsx (+ src/components/admin/pages/**)
   • src/components/ui/** (uiuxSystem.componentInventory)
   • src/styles/cuba-tokens.css, src/styles/cuba-print.css, src/styles/template-pagination.css
2. Backend API & Services:
   • backend/index.js (Express + full securityMiddleware stack)
   • backend/routes/*.js (29 routers per manifest)
   • backend/services/*.js (aiRuntime, docxExport, docxThemes, liveInterviewSession, coverLetterAi, candidateContext, authService)
   • backend/middleware/*.js
   • backend/database/migrations/*.sql (25 stages)
3. Contracts & Evidence:
   • docs/contracts/manifest.json (READ, DO NOT EDIT without Lead approval)
   • docs/contracts/openapi.yaml (keep in sync with openapiInline)
   • docs/contracts/schema.sql (keep in sync with ddlInline)
   • docs/build/tasks.json (task graph)
   • docs/build/fsm/*.json (state machines)
   • docs/build/error-codes.json
4. Testing Harness:
   • tests/** (all 292 suites per manifest)
   • tests/full-system-audit.mjs
   • template-lab/visual-regression.mjs

SECTION 5: SYSTEM INVARIANTS & SYSTEM GUARDS
1. Zero Solo Coding: Antigravity is Lead Supervisor & Release Gatekeeper; all product code authored by Cline.
2. 0-Byte Diff Lock: src/cv-templates/ (51 templates) untouched. Also frozen: docs/contracts/**, src/styles/cuba-tokens.css, src/styles/cuba-print.css, src/styles/template-pagination.css.
3. Dual-Database Authority: MariaDB is ACID system of record; Firestore is async sync node; outbox mutations durable.
4. Security & Tenant Isolation: Strict SQL parameterization (tenant_id) on all tenant-scoped queries; zero plaintext secrets in DOM, logs, or API payloads.
5. Performance & Build Budgets: Build < 4.0s, sub-100ms render, 0 lint errors, zero horizontal overflow 320px–1920px.
6. Idempotency: billing, AI, webhook, upload endpoints MUST enforce idempotency keys per manifest.apiContracts.idempotencyRequiredFor.
7. Webhook Security: HMAC-SHA256 signature verification with 300s timestamp tolerance and replay protection per manifest.securityAndCompliance.webhookSecurity.
8. AI Safety: PII redaction before provider, cost ceilings, circuit breaker, extractJson on all LLM responses, no synthetic fallback.
9. Contract-First: OpenAPI diff must be clean; manifest-consistency gate must pass; token-drift gate must pass.
invariants: INV-1: Strict 0-Byte Diff Lock on src/cv-templates/ (51 templates) AND on docs/contracts/** AND on the three Cuba stylesheets
INV-2: Zero solo application coding by Antigravity; all product code authored by Cline
INV-3: Real MariaDB data wiring with zero mocks or synthetic placeholders in production paths
INV-4: Strict tenant isolation (tenant_id parameterization) on all enterprise database queries
INV-5: Server-only secret storage; zero plaintext API keys in client payloads or logs (per environmentAndSecrets.secretPolicy)
INV-6: extractJson normalization mandatory on all LLM responses; zero synthetic fallback on AI failures
INV-7: WCAG 2.1 AA (contrast >= 4.5:1, touch >= 44x44px, unique landmarks, focus-visible ring)
INV-9: Idempotency keys enforced on POST /api/v1/billing/*, /ai/*, /webhooks/*, /uploads/*
INV-10: All webhooks signed with HMAC-SHA256, 300s timestamp window, replay protection via payment_webhook_events table
INV-11: Every task in docs/build/tasks.json must satisfy its definitionOfDone before being marked complete
INV-12: Every route must implement the uiuxSystem.screenStateMatrix (loading/empty/error/offline/permission-denied/quota-exceeded/stale/partial/success)
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: All 68 routes (manifest.routeInventory.total) operational with zero dead links, zero stubs, and full screenStateMatrix coverage
AC2: OpenAPI contracts (manifest.openapiInline, 17 endpoints) and response envelope { data, error, meta, requestId } validated with zero contract drift; 'npm run test:openapi-diff' clean
AC3: All 117 tables migrated; DDL matches manifest.ddlInline exactly; FK and index policies enforced; backup RPO 15m / RTO 60m verified by restore test
AC4: Multi-provider AI router resilience verified across NVIDIA NIM primary and full failover chain with circuit breaker; extractJson path tested; PII redaction test green
AC5: DOCX adaptive partitioner and @media print contracts verified with zero orphaned headers; visual regression green for all 51 templates
AC6: Responsive multi-viewport lock verified with zero horizontal overflow at all 7 viewports
AC7: Full test pyramid green (manifest.qualityAssuranceAndTesting.totalTestSuites = 292) with coverage >= 80% statements, 0 lint errors, build < 4.0s
AC8: Playwright real-DOM crawl manifest submitted with 0 console errors and 0 failed network requests across all portal shells
AC9: manifest-consistency CI gate green (route/router/table/test/component/task counts all match)
AC10: token-drift, axe, copy-lint, component-states gates green
AC11: Idempotency + webhook HMAC + replay protection tests green
AC12: Every task in docs/build/tasks.json has all evidenceRequired artifacts attached and definitionOfDone satisfied
AC13: Bridge protocol HMAC, nonce, and heartbeat compliance verified; zero missed heartbeats or invalid signatures
AC14: uiuxSystem component inventory implemented; every component has documented variants, states, a11y roles, and token usage

plan.summary: DIR-096 PLAN REVISION v2 (recon complete, ZERO code changed, branch arena/f4651d36-resumepilotai at HEAD e2ad2421). AUTHORITY MODEL per the directive PRIMARY SOURCE OF TRUTH clause: I treat docs/contracts/manifest.json as the single source of truth and docs/build/tasks.json (118 tasks, buildSpecification.totalTasks=118, taskShape TASK-001..TASK-118) as the executable task graph. Every count (routeInventory.total, backendApiTopology.routers, databaseSchema.totalTables, openapiInline, ddlInline, resumeStudioAndTemplates.totalCount, qualityAssuranceAndTesting.totalTestSuites, buildSpecification.totalTasks, uiuxSystem.componentInventory) is READ FROM THE MANIFEST and enforced by the manifest-consistency gate, never restated as prose truth. I add NO task outside the 118-task graph without Lead approval. BLOCKER FOR LEAD RULING (resolved in Wave 1 either way): docs/contracts/ and docs/build/ DO NOT EXIST (Test-Path False) yet INV-1 locks docs/contracts/** at 0-byte diff AND the directive names docs/contracts/manifest.json and docs/build/tasks.json as the authoritative sources. Proposed resolution: bootstrap the manifest projection ONCE from .bridge/project.json (the schema-complete manifest) then freeze docs/contracts/** so generation is idempotent and byte-stable. VERIFIED BASELINE: src/cv-templates/ git diff = 0 bytes (51 templates intact), the three Cuba stylesheets exist and will be held at 0-byte diff per INV-1, npm run test:dir082 6/6 PASS, XAMPP green (Apache 80/443, MySQL 3306, managed backend 8080 healthy). GAPS FOUND (root cause = manifest-declared gates are unimplemented): npm run test:manifest-consistency, test:openapi and test:openapi-diff are MISSING (no scripts, no tests), so AC2/AC9 are currently unprovable. APPROACH: execute the 118-task graph in dependency order as a closed-loop IMPLEMENT then TEST then CRAWL then RCA then FIX then RETEST then COMPARE then PROVE convergence, honoring per-task acceptanceCriteria, evidenceRequired, definitionOfDone and rollbackPlan, with 480s-max heartbeats, 30-minute BLOCKED escalation (buildSpecification.escalationPolicy), server-only secrets (environmentAndSecrets.secretPolicy), and Level 5 evidence. Each wave maps to manifest task ranges and to the 14 ACs and 12 INVs.
steps: WAVE 0 - Baseline and freeze lock - confirm branch/HEAD e2ad2421, prove src/cv-templates/ 0-byte diff AND the three Cuba stylesheets 0-byte diff (INV-1), archive green suites (test:dir082 6/6, test:dir094, test:dir095, test:design-system), record build duration and lint error baseline, verify XAMPP status

WAVE 1 - Materialize the manifest authority - bootstrap docs/contracts/manifest.json (from .bridge/project.json), docs/contracts/openapi.yaml (openapiInline 17 endpoints), docs/contracts/schema.sql (ddlInline 26 DDL), docs/contracts/route-inventory.json, docs/contracts/bridge-message.schema.json, docs/build/tasks.json (118 tasks from buildSpecification), docs/build/error-codes.json and docs/build/fsm/*.json via a new idempotent scripts/generate-manifest-artifacts.mjs, then lock docs/contracts/** (AC9, AC12)

WAVE 2 - Manifest-consistency CI gate (AC9) - author tests/manifest-consistency.test.mjs and wire npm run test:manifest-consistency enforcing every manifestGovernance.countValidation rule (routeInventory.total, backendApiTopology.totalRouters, databaseSchema.totalTables, resumeStudioAndTemplates.totalCount, qualityAssuranceAndTesting.totalTestSuites, uiuxSystem.componentInventory length, buildSpecification.taskGraph length) against the physical codebase and reconcile drift

WAVE 3 - OpenAPI contract conformance (AC2) - author tests/openapi-contract.test.mjs and wire npm run test:openapi and test:openapi-diff, validate the 17 openapiInline endpoints against the routers, assert the response envelope data/error/meta/requestId, pagination, X-Request-Id and X-Tenant-Id headers with zero contract drift

WAVE 4 - MariaDB schema and DDL integrity (AC3, INV-3, INV-4) - verify 117 tables, 25 migrations, 26 inline DDL definitions, FK and index policies, tenant_id parameterization on enterprise queries, and the restore test proving backup RPO 15m and RTO 60m

WAVE 5 - Idempotency, webhooks and replay (AC11, INV-9, INV-10) - enforce idempotency keys on POST /api/v1/billing, /ai, /webhooks and /uploads, HMAC-SHA256 signatures with a 300s window and replay protection via payment_webhook_events, plus regression tests

WAVE 6 - AI multi-provider resilience (AC4, INV-6, INV-5) - verify NVIDIA NIM primary plus full failover chain Nemotron/OpenRouter/Groq/OpenAI with circuit breaker, assert extractJson normalization on every LLM response with zero synthetic fallback, PII redaction and cost controls green, server-only secrets

WAVE 7 - Export pipeline and template parity (AC5, INV-1) - verify the DOCX adaptive partitioner and @media print contracts with zero orphaned headers and visual regression green for all 51 templates, holding src/cv-templates/ at 0-byte diff

WAVE 8 - Four-portal route integrity and screen-state matrix (AC1, INV-12) - reconcile all 68 manifest routes against src/main.jsx, prove zero dead links or stubs, and confirm every route implements uiuxSystem.screenStateMatrix (loading/empty/partial/error/offline/permission-denied/quota-exceeded/stale/success)

WAVE 9 - UI/UX, design system and accessibility lock (AC6, AC10, AC14, INV-7, INV-8) - verify the 4-level build-resume breadcrumb (Dashboard > Resumes & Master CV > Build Resume > name) from xl up with ancestor links to /dashboard, zero hardcoded data (values bound to real DB/API/calculateAtsScore), the 12-component uiuxSystem.componentInventory with variants/states/a11y/tokens, WCAG 2.1 AA, zero horizontal overflow at 320/375/768/1024/1280/1440/1920, and token-drift/axe/copy-lint/component-states gates green

WAVE 10 - Full test pyramid and build budget (AC7) - run all manifest.qualityAssuranceAndTesting.totalTestSuites suites for 0 failures and 0 lint errors with coverage at or above 80% statements and build under 4.0s
WAVE 11 - Real-DOM Playwright crawl (AC8) - produce a crawl manifest across all portal shells with 0 console errors and 0 failed network requests at all 7 viewports

WAVE 12 - Evidence and gatekeeper certification (AC12, AC13, INV-11) - attach every task evidenceRequired artifact, satisfy definitionOfDone and rollbackPlan, verify bridge protocol HMAC/nonce/heartbeat compliance, submit Level 5 evidence via bridge dev submit-evidence and await APPROVED_FROZEN
